notes: Summary: Thunderbloom is a product analytics mid-market SaaS (250 eng + product). Started on Hosted API for MVP features (in-app help bot + doc search). Now evaluating Dedicated for production scale and data isolation.
POC ask: 60-day Dedicated trial scoped as: staging canary (10% traffic), then ramp to 50% over 4 weeks, with automatic fallback to Hosted model variants in case of errors/latency spikes.

Canary + fallback plan (high level): - Canary runs on Dedicated pool in us-west-2, 10% of sessions for initial 2 weeks. - Monitoring: p50/p95 latency, token cost-per-request, 5xx rate, semantic drift score from test prompts. - Fallbacks: primary fallback to Redwood-hosted compatible model (same architecture, quantized variant) in us-east-1. - Model variants: Prod-1 (redwood/gptx-13b-q4), Safe-1 (redwood/gptx-13b-q8), Fallback-hosted (redwood/gpt-medium-8bit). - Rollback policy: automatic rollback to hosted variant if 5xx > 0.5% for 10m or p95 latency > 1.5x SLO for 15m; manual rollback if semantic regression observed in daily eval set.

Acceptance criteria for POC: - Avg response latency p95 < 450ms for chat flow at 4k reqs/day test load. - Token cost delta vs hosted < 1.2x after batching. - No data exfiltration issues in security scan. - Semantic QA: pass 95% of regression prompt set.

SE notes: will provide canary routing policy snippet and model alias mapping; recommended KV-prefix cache for common help queries to reduce tokens. Suggested batching window tuning: 10ms for low-latency interactive flows.
CTO quote from 2026-02-28: 'If we can match hosted latency and guarantee EU residency for EU customers, we'll move forward with Dedicated monthly commit.'

Security ask: SSO + SCIM, SOC2 attestation, audit logs to be forwarded to their Splunk instance, KMS integration needed for key separation. Legal flagged data residency for EU customers; require option to pin customer EU traffic to EU region or use private deployment later.

Finance model: prefixed pricing band acceptable if estimation +/- 20% flexible; requested usage report granularity down to route/model. Requested Redwood to include cost projection for 6 months with expected ramp.

POC runbook stubs: - Day 0: deploy Dedicated pool + model variant; configure canary router rule. - Week 1: smoke tests with synthetic prompts + latency load. - Week 2: open canary to 10% production traffic. - Week 3-6: ramp, monitor, run daily evals, decide commit. - Exit: either convert to reserved commit or revert to hosted with deprovisioning plan.
